svg.title: 35mmIsle — a forgotten camera, a familiar island
svg.desc: A colorful anime-inspired tropical beach. A weathered silver and navy film SLR sits partly buried in a continuous drift of golden sand, beside a coral woven strap and a seashell. A volcanic island, glowing crater and turquoise water reflect in its rounded lens. Bright blue sky, jade surf, emerald palms and small tropical flowers surround the camera. Original cream and deep-teal 35mmIsle lettering fills the upper-left corner.
